# .Huge[**.yellow[Things that I learned]**] <br> while serving the committee for 3+ years.

---

.full-width-green[
# Before the submission, do know:
]
<br>

--

# 1. The committee does not conduct a .purple[separate] investigation.

--

## - The decision is made based .orange[solely] on the evidence you submit.

--

## - As a referring party, you are making an .green[argument].

--

# 2. Lots of cases come in as 'in abstentia'.

--

## - No reason to pre-emptively give up.

---

.full-width-blue[
# While making the submission, do know:
]
<br>

--

# 1. .blue[Patterns] are the single most convincing evidence, particularly for CHSS cases.

--

## - Talk to students (for education); but also .pink[collect] evidence.

--

# 2. Students are .red[distressed] once a case is filed.

--

## - Even when they are clearly responsible.

--

## - AC Office is quite reliable.
